question: Kailan kailangan ng CPDO validation para sa Occupancy Permit at magkano ang filing fee para sa 3-storey na gusali?
answer: The CPDO validation is required for Occupancy Permit based on the Integrated Zoning Ordinance (2019-2028) for 3-storey buildings and above and building floor area of 1,500 square meters and above. The filing fee for this process is PHP 150.00. [S1, S5]

ground_truth: Under the Integrated Zoning Ordinance (2019–2028), CPDO executes mandatory Validation of Occupancy Permits for structures that are 3-storeys and above OR possess a building floor area of 1,500 square meters and above. Requirements are: 1) Approved Building Plans (1 original); 2) Approved Building Permit from OBO (1 original); 3) Certificate of Occupancy Form (1 original); 4) Locational Clearance photocopy; and 5) Actual pictures of the building (1 original). The filing fee is PHP 150.00, and processing time is 3 Days, 2 Hours, and 10 Minutes.
